A '''castle''' was owned by the family of [[Esano]]. His family ran the [[Kozinarg Trade Guilds]], and after [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] freed [[Esano's sister]], who had been kidnapped by [[the Scourge]] and taken to [[Orto Norwe]], they brought her to her family's [[Castle/Legends|castle]] on [[Pleem's Nexus]] in exchange for a share of her wealth. As the brothers were loading their reward onto their [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], however, a [[Unidentified task force (Plo Koon)|Jedi task force]] arrived and engaged the brothers in a [[Skirmish on Pleem's Nexus|skirmish]] on a landing pad at the castle.
